tools.name: find_yachts
tools.description: Search YachtFinder's catalogue of more than 20,000 yachts by builder, length, asking price, build year, status (for sale, for charter, reported sold, not for sale) and place. Returns up to 25 yachts, longest first by default, each with her status, the broker's asking price, YachtFinder's estimate wh

tools.name: yachts_near
tools.description: List the yachts whose latest AIS position, as yachtfinder.co publishes it, lies within a radius of a named harbor or anchorage (e.g. "Port Hercule", "Antibes", "Off Monaco") or of a latitude and longitude. By default only positions from the last 24 hours. Each yacht comes with the time of her fix, h

tools.name: yacht_facts
tools.description: One yacht's facts from YachtFinder: builder, year, length, status, the broker's asking price (never a sale price), YachtFinder's estimate where her page shows one, her published AIS position with its time, where her listing says she is, and her page on yachtfinder.co, with the source and date of eac

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_yachts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
